numerals.purpose: Times, counts, dates in data, member numbers. Tabular.

mark.purpose: The BBH letters inside the rounded ochre square. Nowhere else.

shadows.name: photo

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Black pill for the one primary action on paper or ochre.
components.css: .ds-btn { background: #15130f; color: #f5f4ef; border: 1.5px solid transparent; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 10px 20px; font: 500 16px/24px 'Geist Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), background-color 200ms; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn:hover { background: #2b2823; } .ds-btn:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #15130f; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ochre Button
components.description: The primary action when it sits on a black panel.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-ochre">Reserve a seat to read the board</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-ochre { background: #d39b2a; color: #15130f; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 10px 20px; font: 500 16px/24px 'Geist Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), background-color 200ms; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-ochre:hover { background: #a9761a; } .ds-btn-ochre:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-ochre:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f5f4ef; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Field
components.description: 48px paper field with a hairline; ink on focus, rust when invalid.
components.html: <label class="ds-label">Business name<input class="ds-input" placeholder="Lim Builders Supply"></label>
components.css: .ds-label { display: block; font: 500 14px/20px 'Geist Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #15130f; } .ds-input { display: block; margin-top: 6px; width: 100%; height: 48px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid #d9d6cb; border-radius: 12px; background: #f5f4ef; color: #15130f; font: 400 16px/24px 'Geist Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; caret-color: #a9761a; transition: border-color 200ms; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: rgb(81 76 67 / .75); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #15130f; outline: 2px solid #15130f; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-input[aria-invalid=true] { border-color: #a8321f; }

components.name: Filter Pill
components.description: News filters and board section pills; solid ink when active.
components.css: .ds-pills { display: flex; gap: 4px; } .ds-pill { border: 1px solid #d9d6cb; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 6px 12px; background: transparent; color: #514c43; font: 600 12px/16px 'Geist Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-pill:hover { border-color: #15130f; } .ds-pill[aria-pressed=true] { background: #15130f; border-color: #15130f; color: #f5f4ef; } .ds-pill:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #15130f; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Surface Card
components.description: Raised paper card with a hairline and a long soft shadow.
components.html:
Next breakfast · Thu, Nov 5 · 6:30 AM

Sample venue, Cebu IT Park
components.css: .ds-card { background: #fbfaf7; border: 1px solid #d9d6cb; border-radius: 16px; padding: 12px 16px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(21 19 15 / .04), 0 18px 40px -24px rgb(21 19 15 / .28); font-family: 'Geist Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card-t { margin: 0; font: 500 14px/20px inherit; color: #15130f; } .ds-card-s { margin: 0; font: 400 12px/16px inherit; color: #514c43; }

components.name: Dark Panel
components.description: Coal panel for the board sign, member card and footer.
components.css: .ds-panel { background: #1d1b17; color: #f5f4ef; border: 1px solid #2b2823; border-radius: 32px; padding: 40px; box-shadow: 0 24px 48px -28px rgb(21 19 15 / .6); font-family: 'Geist Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-panel-k { margin: 0; font: 500 14px/20px inherit; color: rgb(245 244 239 / .7); } .ds-panel-n { margin: 8px 0 0; color: #d39b2a; font: 500 96px/1 'Geist Mono Variable', ui-monospace, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: BBH Mark
components.description: BBH in a condensed sans inside a rounded ochre line square.
components.css: .ds-mark { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; width: 36px; height: 36px; box-sizing: border-box; border: 2px solid #d39b2a; border-radius: 10px; font: 600 15px/1 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .02em; color: #15130f; }

narrative.overview:
BBH's own colours lead: a deep yellow ochre and black. Ochre carries the big moments (the hero and the closing invitation), black carries the type, the buttons and the dark panels, and a quiet off-white ground sits between them so the page can breathe. The feel is sophisticated and casual, like a good café before opening: unfussy, warm and grown up. It's never cartoony.

The table is still the idea, but it's real. The hero is a top-down photograph of a set breakfast table, with live seat markers placed on the place settings. On `/join` the seat picker is a fine line floor plan of the table. The place card turns over into a black member card.
keyCharacteristics: Big flat fields of yellow ochre with black type on them.
Black pill buttons for the primary action. On black panels the action becomes an ochre pill.
Hairline rules and soft, long shadows. No thick borders, no outlines drawn as decoration.
Geist at weight 500 for headings, Geist Mono for times and counts, and a condensed sans only inside the BBH square mark.
Real photography, plus fine line drawing where a photo can't work.

rules.name: The Brand Field Rule
rules.body: Ochre appears as a field (a whole band or section) or as a small signal (open seat, you, the mark). It is never a mid-sized tint scattered around.

rules.name: The One Black Button Rule
rules.body: Each screen has one primary action, a black pill. On a black panel it inverts to an ochre pill.

rules.name: The Named Style Rule
rules.body: Text uses a named style class. Don't set a loose size and weight.

rules.name: The Plain Copy Rule
rules.body: No hyphens inside sentences, no italics, sentence case.

dos: **Do** let ochre fill whole fields, with black type on them.
**Do** use real photography of tables, food and people, and credit stand-in photos.
**Do** use hairlines and space for structure.
**Do** label every piece of dummy content as Sample.
**Do** give every interactive element hover, pressed (0.97), visible focus, disabled and error states.
donts: **Don't** draw cartoon or pop-art illustrations, or use flat icon food.
**Don't** use gradients on backgrounds or text.
**Don't** use thick borders, coloured side borders, or hard offset shadows.
**Don't** use the condensed face outside the BBH mark, or use italics.
**Don't** put kickers or eyebrow labels above headings.
**Don't** invent real BBH facts such as fees, venues, how often they meet or member counts.
